messages.content: 進行兩個獨立樣本的假設檢定，樣本1的分數為[22,33,42,12,34]，樣本2的分數為[23,45,44,14,38]，顯著性水平為0.05。

function.name: hypothesis_testing_ttest_ind
function.description: Conducts a hypothesis test for two independent samples. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample1.description: First set of observations (array of numbers).

sample2.description: Second set of observations (array of numbers).

significance_level.description: Significance level of the test (default: 0.05) This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to perform an independent samples t-test. We have sample1: [22,33,42,12,34], sample2: [23,45,44,14,38]. Use significance level 0.05. Compute means, variances, pooled variance? Let's compute.

Sample1: n1=5. Sum1 = 22+33+42+12+34 = 143. Mean1 = 143/5 = 28.6. Compute sum of squares: deviations squared: (22-28.6)^2 = (-6.6)^2 = 43.56; (33-28.6)=4.4^2=19.36; (42-28.6)=13.4^2=179.56; (12-28.6)=-16.6^2=275.56; (34-28.6)=5.4^2=29.16. Sum of squared deviations = 43.56+19.36+179.56+275.56+29.16 = 547.2. Sample variance s1^2 = sum/(n1-1) = 547.2/4 = 136.8. So s1^2 = 136.8.

Sample2: n2=5. Sum2 = 23+45+44+14+38 = 164. Mean2 = 164/5 = 32.8. Deviations: (23-32.8)=-9.8^2=96.04; (45-32.8)=12.2^2=148.84; (44-32.8)=11.2^2=125.44; (14-32.8)=-18.8^2=353.44; (38-32.8)=5.2^2=27.04. Sum = 96.04+148.84+125.44+353.44+27.04 = 750.8. Sample variance s2^2 = 750.8/4 = 187.7.

Now compute t-statistic for equal variances assumption? Usually we can use Welch's t-test if unequal variances. But we can compute both. Let's do Welch's t-test: t = (mean1 - mean2)/sqrt(s1^2/n1 + s2^2/n2). mean difference = 28.6-32.8 = -4.2. Standard error sqrt(136.8/5 + 187.7/5) = sqrt(27.36 + 37.54) = sqrt(64.9) = 8.055. t = -4.2 / 8.055 = -0.521. Degrees of freedom approximate using Welch-Satterthwaite: df = (s1^2/n1 + s2^2/n2)^2 / [(s1^2/n1)^2/(n1-1) + (s2^2/n2)^2/(n2-1)]. Compute numerator: (27.36+37.54)^2 = 64.9^2 = 4212.01. Denominator: (27.36^2)/(4) + (37.54^2)/(4) = (748.5)/4 + (1408.5)/4 = 187.125 + 352.125 = 539.25. df = 4212.01/539.25 ≈ 7.81. So df ~7.8.

Compute p-value two-tailed: t = -0.521 with df=7.8. The absolute t = 0.521. For df=8, critical t at alpha=0.05 two-tailed is about 2.306. Our t is far less than that, so fail to reject null. p-value > 0.05. Let's approximate p-value: Using t distribution table or approximate: For df=8, t=0.52 gives p>0.60 maybe. So p-value ~0.61. So we cannot reject null.

Alternatively, if we assume equal variances and use pooled variance: sp^2 = ((n1-1)s1^2 + (n2-1)s2^2)/(n1+n2-2) = (4*136.8 + 4*187.7)/8 = (547.2+750.8)/8 = 1298/8 = 162.25. Pooled standard error = sqrt(sp^2*(1/n1+1/n2)) = sqrt(162.25*(0.2+0.2)) = sqrt(162.25*0.4) = sqrt(64.9) = 8.055 again same as above because sp^2 yields same? Actually sp^2=162.25, times 0.4 = 64.9, sqrt = 8.055. So t = -4.2/8.055 = -0.521. df = n1+n2-2 = 8. So same t. So p-value similar.

Thus conclusion: fail to reject H0 at alpha=0.05. Provide test statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value, decision.
